ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the diagram below, which organisms will be most directly affected by a decrease in the amount of frog?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The diagram is a schematic diagram of a food chain, labeled FLOWER (Producer), CATERPILLAR (Consumer), FROG (Consumer), SNAKE (Consumer), OWL (Consumer). In the diagram, frog and snake can be seen adjacent to each other, and there is an arrow from frog pointing to snake, indicating that the snake directly follows the frog in the food chain. Then reason: The question asks when the number of frog decreases, which organism will be most directly affected. In the food chain, the snake immediately after frog depends on frog as food, so a decrease in frog will most directly affect snake.
